name: NY-15
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Ritchie Torres running with $14M cash on hand
Republican challenger with no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price Democratic win at 98%
model.rationale: NY-15's D+27 lean, Torres's incumbency and overwhelming financial advantage, and a Republican opponent with no visible campaign resources all point to a lopsided Democratic win; markets agree at 98%. No evidence suggests any meaningful threat.
model.watch: A surprise primary-style challenge or major scandal could tighten the race, but nothing in the current evidence points that way.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Ritchie Torres seeks reelection in a Bronx-based district that leans Democratic by 27 points. He has raised nearly $7 million and holds about $14 million in cash, with outside groups supporting him and none opposing. His Republican challenger, Stylo Sapaskis, shows no reported fundraising, and minor independent candidates have raised only small amounts.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at 98 percent, and no expert ratings or general-election polls flag the race as competitive. The fundamentals, money, and market pricing all align on a comfortable Democratic hold.
